sources.entry: Minecraft Server | Docker image for Minecraft Java servers with mod and plugin support

summary.one_liner: A Docker image that runs Minecraft Java Edition servers with configuration via environment variables, plus support for mods, plugins, and modpacks.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a short index pointing to the main documentation and examples. It covers running Minecraft Java Edition under Docker, including a Docker Compose quick start and selecting different Minecraft versions and server types. Server properties are set through container environment variables. The image can download and clean up mods and plugins automatically and works with several modpack providers or platforms. The README says the image supports Java Edition only and points Bedrock users to a separate project, itzg/minecraft-bedrock-server. Example configurations are in an examples directory. The README also lists third-party hosting products built on this image, which are not part of the project itself.
use_cases: host a Minecraft Java server in Docker
run a Minecraft server with mods or plugins
deploy a modded Minecraft server from a modpack
configure Minecraft server properties via environment variables
set up a Minecraft server with Docker Compose
how_to_run: Follow the Quick start with Docker Compose section in the README
Browse the examples directory for sample configurations
notable: Server types and Minecraft versions selected through container configuration
Automated mod and plugin downloads with cleanup
Supports multiple modpack providers or platforms
Example configurations included in the repository
caveats: Java Edition only; Bedrock Edition requires a different project (itzg/minecraft-bedrock-server)
README is an index and gives no detailed install steps; details are in the external docs and examples
